title: Shape Design for a Class of Degenerate Parabolic Equations with Boundary Point Degeneracy and Its Application to Boundary Observability
summary: We study a class of degenerate parabolic equations with boundary point degeneracy in dimensions N>=2 and investigate the associated boundary observability problem by means of shape design. While one-dimensional degenerate models have been treated in the literature, the genuinely higher-dimensional case remains much more delicate because the degeneracy occurs at a boundary point and the boundary normal trace cannot be extracted directly near the singularity.
